channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Decline to accelerate below 99.40
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) edges up against its peers on Monday after a vertical decline on Friday. At press time, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trades marginally higher to near 99.70.

item.title: Brent: Cautious trade with geopolitical risks – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Bas van Geffen notes that talks on reopening Hormuz are progressing slowly, with Iran adding new conditions on the United States (US), keeping geopolitical risk elevated for Oil.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Positions above nine-day EMA near 183.00
item.description: EUR/JPY rises after registering losses in the previous day, trading around 183.10 during the European hours on Monday. The currency cross is holding a capped tone as it sits below the 50-day Exponential moving average (EMA) while clinging to short-term support at the nine-day EMA.

item.title: British Pound: Soft GDP could trigger dovish BoE repricing – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad argues that the British Pound (GBP) requires a stronger-than-expected United Kingdom (UK) Gross Domestic Product (GDP) print to gain upside traction.

item.title: Australian Dollar flat above 0.7050 vs USD, close to June 16 peak as traders await RBA
item.description: The AUD/USD pair enters a bullish consolidation phase at the start of the new week as traders opt to move to the sidelines ahead of the crucial Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) meeting on Tuesday.

item.title: Equities: Falling oil and AI rebound drive record highs - Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists report that falling energy prices and softer Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations helped push the S&P 500 and other major equity indices to new record highs last week.

item.title: Euro dips further against the British Pound, weighed by higher Oil prices
item.description: The Euro (EUR) posts mild losses against the British Pound (GBP) on Monday, with the EUR/GBP pair testing Friday’s lows at 0.8560, as the situation in the Middle East muddles and Crude prices tick up, adding pressure on the Eurozone’s Oil-importing economies.

item.title: Canadian Dollar weakens as US Dollar strengthens on rising risk aversion
item.description: USD/CAD gains ground after registering over 0.5% losses in the previous day, trading around 1.3950 during the early European hours on Monday. The pair gains ground as the US Dollar (USD) strengthens on rising safe-haven demand, driven by heightened geopolitical caution.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention credibility questioned – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu and David Tam highlight that USD/JPY is grinding higher again after Japan’s recent intervention, with the Japanese Yen (JPY) having already surrendered much of its gains.

item.title: Indian Rupee drops tracking higher oil prices, downside seems limited
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a negative note against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR pair rebounds to near 95.25 as oil prices extend their recovery move and the US Dollar regains ground after a weak Friday.

item.title: Forex Today: Post-NFP US Dollar selloff pauses
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Monday, August 10:

item.title: Gold climbs back to $4,350; remains below June 17 high as USD sticks to gains
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) reverses a modest intraday dip and climbs to the top boundary of its daily range, closer to the $4,350 level heading into the European session on Monday.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Hawkish risk before RBA – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank expects the RBA to keep rates unchanged, in line with market pricing, but sees scope for a slightly hawkish tone given high petroleum prices and already reduced hike expectations.

item.title: British Pound outperforms at the start of the UK Q2 GDP data week
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades higher against its major currency peers and is marginally up at around 1.3500 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Bounces up from lows with bulls aiming for 158.65
item.description: The US Dollar has retraced previous losses against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Monday, with the USD/JPY pair returning above the 158.00 line, after bouncing up from Friday’s low, at 156.68. The pair has regained some momentum, and bulls are aiming at last week's highs, in the 158.65 area.

item.title: Euro: Weak US jobs lift EUR against US Dollar on Fed repricing – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that the US Dollar (USD) weakened after a softer US jobs report, allowing EUR/USD to briefly reach its highest level in almost two months.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Eyes further upside towards 1.1620
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades subduedly at around 1.1550 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Monday. The EUR/USD pair edges down as the US Dollar rebounds after a significant fall on Friday.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Bulls await sustained move above $78.00 amid supply concerns
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – kicks off the new week on a positive note amid the US-Iran standoff over the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah struggles as Consumer Confidence drops to weakest level since September 2025
item.description: USD/IDR holds gains after registering over 0.5% losses in the previous trading day, hovering around 17,860 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair continues to trade with an upward bias as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces pressure following the release of domestic Consumer Confidence data.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Swiss Franc declines as safe-haven demand supports US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF inches higher after registering over 0.5% losses in the previous trading day, hovering around 0.8090 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar drifts lower as USD recovers from post-NFP lows amid Mideast jitters
item.description: The NZD/USD pair is seen extending Friday's late pullback from the vicinity of the monthly peak – levels just above the 0.5900 mark – and drifting lower at the start of a new week.

item.title: United States Dollar Index advances above 99.50 due to Middle East risks
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is gaining ground after registering modest losses in the previous day and trading around 99.70 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD starts US CPI week on flat note around $63.50
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades in a tight range at around $63.50 during the Asian trading session at the start of the week. The white metal struggles for direction but is close to an almost seven-week high of $65.16 posted on Friday.

item.title: Australian Dollar weakens as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
item.description: AUD/USD inches lower after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 0.7060 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair holds losses as the US Dollar (USD) receives support from broad risk aversion.

item.title: Canadian Dollar pulls back from two-month top as rebounding USD counters higher oil prices
item.description: The USD/CAD pair attracts some dip-buyers at the start of a new week and recovers a part of Friday's heavy losses to the 1.3925 area, or a nearly two-month low.

item.title: Japanese Yen comes under pressure as BoJ division, unexpected current account deficit
item.description: USD/JPY gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 158.20 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: British Pound moves away from multi-week top as Hormuz risks support USD
item.description: The GBP/USD pair edges lower at the start of a new week and moves further away from an over three-week high, or levels just above the 1.3500 psychological mark touched on Friday.

item.title: Euro consolidates below its highest level since June 17 as Mideast tensions support USD
item.description: The EUR/USD pair kicks off the new week on a subdued note and trades just above 1.1550 during the Asian session, well within striking distance of a fresh high since June 17, touched in reaction to the disappointing US jobs data on Friday.

item.title: Hormuz tensions escalate as unconfirmed missile attack amid fragile US-Iran talks
item.description: The ongoing US-Iran conflict has entered a crucial diplomatic phase, with intense fighting and strategic pressure around the vital Strait of Hormuz continuing to drive the dynamic of the war.
